reason: This plugin is primarily an external-service integration tool for DeepSeek Harness, focused on extending the WebUI custom provider flow with configurable request metadata and model behavior (headers, image capability, reasoning settings) for third-party API endpoints, with effects visible in conversation model selection and model capability handling.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 的 WebUI 扩展自定义模型提供商设置，可让用户在自定义提供商中配置请求头、UA、图像输入能力与推理级别，并在对话中按模型使用这些设置。
summaries.en: This plugin extends the DeepSeek Harness WebUI for custom providers by letting users configure request headers, model capabilities, and reasoning levels for third-party API calls and conversations.

capabilities: Customize HTTP request headers (including User-Agent) for custom model providers
Define per-model input capability, including text+image support
Configure model-level reasoning effort options and defaults
Apply custom header settings to model usage and model-discovery requests
Persist provider-level custom settings in DeepSeek Harness configuration

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds request headers, image capability, and reasoning-level controls to user-defined custom providers.
README notes these settings affect normal model requests and "Fetch available models", confirming outbound provider request behavior is influenced by user input.
package.json declares a web platform DSH client plugin with injection of connection and API-remote UI/client modules, indicating integration with external model services through the WebUI.
